info.title: Revelation SRS Wellbeing API
info.description: Wellbeing module: disability support, adjustments, EC claims, mental health and early warning

post.summary: Record an assessment (the assessor is the signed-in user)
Record a panel decision (the chair is the signed-in user)
Approve and hand off to the SRS
Record an evidence review (the reviewer is the signed-in user)
Determine the claim (the authoriser is the signed-in user)

get.summary: List a person's mental health cases
Export a person's wellbeing data (subject access request)

post.summary: Apply retention to cases past their date
